ask:e6f324f89bffe15d99766d1cbc2f4cff8bbc.question: For 30% O2 at 10.2 psi, what is the nearest tested condition, matched on O2 partial pressure or on mole fraction?

sentences.text: For the assumed scenario input of 30 mol% O2 at 70.3 kPa (10.2 psi) with an O2 partial pressure of 21.09 kPa, the closest tested run by O2 concentration on SIBAL material is SAF-VI-2 at 31 mol% O2, though it was conducted at 54.1 kPa total pressure and 16.77 kPa O2 partial pressure.
By O2 partial pressure on SIBAL material, the closest tested run is SAF-IV-1 with an O2 partial pressure of 22 kPa, recorded at 22 mol% O2 and 100 kPa total pressure.
Additionally, run SAF-V-2 tested a cotton jersey fabric at 26.2 mol% O2, 70.7 kPa total pressure, and 18.52 kPa O2 partial pressure.

answer.limit: The available records only include microgravity (0 g) flight data, whereas lunar gravity (0.165 g) is requested in the scenario. Results from microgravity do not bound lunar behavior, as partial gravity environments like lunar gravity may present different flammability dynamics.

next.target: Flame spread testing of SIBAL fabric under actual lunar gravity (0.165 g) at 30 mol% O2 and 70.3 kPa total pressure.

answer.scope: In our curated dataset; illustrative, not an approved NASA plan.
